artworks.title: Deer Resting in Albury Park
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on Whatman laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon line is in the middle, with rolling hills that rise and fall towards the right. The artwork features delicate brushstrokes, resembling watercolor, giving a soft quality to the trees and clouds. The color palette includes muted tones like pale blues, gentle greens, and soft grays. In the foreground, a small herd of deer is depicted. On the left, a group of trees stands tall. In the distance, misty mountains and trees are visible.

artworks.title: Prudence [recto]
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person, captured in full body from head to toe. The person is standing with a slight lean, with one hand raised towards the chest and the other resting on the hip. The face is turned slightly to the side, with minimal details for the eyes, nose, and mouth. The hair is long and swept back. The clothing is depicted as flowing robes or drapery, with emphasis on the folds and fluid movement. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the person's hands. The background is plain, showing the texture of the paper with no additional elements.

artworks.title: Prudence [verso]
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a full-length figure of a person standing in a slightly turned position with the head turned to the left. The facial features are minimal, and the hair is styled simply. The individual wears draped, flowing garments that suggest a robe or gown, with folds and layers adding volume and texture. The figure's arms are bent at the elbows, holding up a portion of the garment. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is plain, drawing attention solely to the figure. The artwork is rendered in reddish-brown hues, indicative of a sepia or sanguine sketch on paper.

artworks.title: Head of a Youth
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features a sketch of a person's head and upper part of the neck, slightly turned to the right. The person has defined facial features such as a rounded face, prominent cheeks, and closely drawn eyes and lips. The hair is styled in loose, flowing strands that partially frame the face. The person is not wearing any visible clothing or accessories in the sketch. The drawing is done in a reddish tone on paper, with a background of an empty or plain textured surface.

artworks.title: Two Nudes Fighting
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper; laid down

artworks.title: Landscape with a Man and a Dog
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch of a wooded landscape with a figure in period clothing walking along a path with a dog. The trees are detailed with intricate lines, creating a sense of movement and texture. The artwork is in grayscale, focusing on light and shadow. The trees transition from the foreground to the background, creating a tranquil forest scene. The composition is naturalistic with gentle, flowing strokes guiding the viewer's eye.

artworks.title: Sketches of Heads and Hands
artworks.medium: red and black chalks on orange prepared laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a sketch displaying a face, hands, and torso. The face shows detailed facial features like eyes, nose, and lips without hair. It is in a three-quarter view facing slightly to the right. Below the face are two hands, one in the center with curved fingers and the other on the left holding an unseen object. Above the hands is a partially drawn torso at an angle. There is no indication of clothing or jewelry. The background is a neutral-toned surface.

artworks.title: Designs for Palatial Staircases [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural sketches. The drawing shows various sketches of architectural elements and staircases, including perspectives and cross-sections of arches, stairwells, and entranceways with intricate details. The images are rendered in ink on paper, displaying precise and complex lines that suggest a study of architectural design, potentially including ground plan and elevation views of structures.

artworks.title: Designs for Palatial Arches [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural sketches that feature stairs and arches. The drawing shows various studies of architectural elements such as vaulted arches, staircases, and columns. The sketches are rendered in a loose, freehand style, and appear to be explorations or studies rather than finished compositions. Shading and line work are used to convey depth and dimension within the structures.

artworks.title: Prophet and Sybil
artworks.artist: Italian 16th Century, after Jacopo Zanguidi, called Bertoia
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite, heightened with white, on two joined sheets of laid paper, mounted to canvas
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a frieze featuring classical mythological figures in dynamic poses within an ornate architectural setting with floral elements and scrollwork. Cherubic figures assist larger beings in the scene. The drawing is monochromatic with detailed line work and shadowing, creating depth and richness.

artworks.title: A Mythological Scene with Sea Gods
artworks.medium: brown wash and pen and brown ink over graphite, heightened with white, on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows three human figures and a cherub. Two figures are seated upright, while the third reclines on a draped surface. The two upright figures have refined facial features and styled hair, with one possibly adorned with a garland. The reclining figure, also with styled hair, is partially covered, with a focus on her extended lower body and exposed upper body. The figures' clothing is depicted in loose drapes. A small cherub-like figure with wings is engaging with them, holding an object resembling a mirror or tambourine. An additional reclining cherub is next to the third figure. The setting features flowing, expressive lines against an abstract, muted background with no distinct objects or structures.

artworks.title: Sacrifice [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elderly figure with a long beard interacting with a younger figure holding a book. The illustration shows an exchange or imparting of knowledge. The figures are adorned in draped clothing. The style features minimalist lines and shading to capture expressions and forms efficiently.

artworks.title: Designs for Vases [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of large decorative vessels and intricate urns drawn in brown ink. The vessels occupy most of the space in the image, and the palette is limited to brown ink on a cream-colored background. The largest vase is on the left side, with a prominent neck and elaborate handles; next to it, a tall, slender bottle; and towards the right, multiple urns with ornate lids and carved details. The vessels are densely positioned, taking up nearly the entire frame.

artworks.title: Travelers on a Road in a Wooded Landscape
artworks.medium: black chalk and graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is above the midpoint, with clusters of trees. The sketch is done with fine, cross-hatched pencil strokes, creating texture in the foliage and sky. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey and black. A path winds through dense foliage, leading to figures walking and riding a horse. In the background, the trees become denser, with birds in the sky.

artworks.title: Standing Man
artworks.medium: red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person standing. The figure is facing slightly towards the viewer's right, with the head turned slightly to their right. The facial features are lightly detailed. The hair appears short and possibly tucked under a head wrap or cap. The person is dressed in a long, draped garment that envelops their body, extending down to the feet, and appears to have multiple layers. The hands are positioned near the front of the body, holding the fabric of the garment. The background is a plain surface.

artworks.title: Two Standing Putti [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The sketch depicts two cherubic figures, both shown fully from head to toe. The figure on the left is in a dynamic stance with one arm raised and the other resting across the chest. It has curly hair and wings. The figure on the right stands upright with weight on one leg, slightly tilting its head. It also has curly hair and wings. Both figures are nude and shaded to emphasize their rounded bodies. The background is plain with a paper texture.

artworks.title: Roman Ruins with a Sepulchre
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with watercolor on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows the interior of a stone structure with views of ancient ruins outside. There is an archway with stone carvings and columns in the foreground. Detailed elements like tombs and statues are visible on the right. In the distance, there are more ruins, trees, and buildings. The painting features gentle brushstrokes, creating light and shadow play on stone surfaces. The color palette consists of muted earth tones like gray and brown, lending an aged quality to the scene. Shadows and highlights create depth and atmosphere in the composition.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Man [recto]
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up drawing of a person's head and shoulders. The person is slightly tilted to the right, with their gaze downward. The facial features are detailed, with a focus on the eyes and lips. They have medium-length hair flowing around their face. The individual is wearing a garment with an indistinct collar. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the image. The background is a plain, lightly textured surface.

artworks.title: A Woodland Pond
artworks.medium: charcoal and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a natural landscape seen from a slightly elevated angle. The scene includes a body of water, trees, shrubs, and foliage. The foreground shows vegetation by the water, while the midground is filled with trees and shrubs. The artwork features loose and expressive brushwork with a monochromatic color palette of varying shades of gray and black on a beige or off-white background.

artworks.title: A Man Looking Out a Window
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a bent-forward stance, with his upper body and head visible. His profile is turned to the side, displaying a side view of his face. The man has curly hair and seems to be wearing a hat or hood. He wears a long robe or tunic with gathered sleeves and a belt around his waist. The man is reaching forward with both hands. The background is a simple, flat surface with a plain texture and light shading.

artworks.title: Study for a Ceiling: Allegory of the Harvest with Dionysus and Ceres
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown inks with gray and brown washes on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures and cherubs amidst clouds. The drawing features numerous figures seated or flying among swirling clouds. The most prominent figure is floating or ascending on the left with a flowing cloak, while other smaller figures resemble cherubs with curly hair and playful demeanor. Additional clouds and abstract designs are in the background, contributing to the ethereal and dynamic quality of the scene. The style is reminiscent of Giovanni Domenico Tiepolo.

artworks.title: Cleopatra
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image displays swirling and flowing lines that form an abstract composition. The lines resemble towering columns and faint outlines of chandeliers, suggesting a grand architectural setting reminiscent of ancient temples or palatial interiors.

artworks.title: Christian Martyrs
artworks.medium: black chalk and brown washes, heightened with white, on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angelic figure and fallen individuals within a grand architectural setting. The drawing presents a somber scene. In the foreground, there are individuals lying on the ground, dressed in long robes, some motionless. One of these figures features a faint halo above its head. The upper portion of the drawing is dominated by an angel with outstretched wings, descending from above. The background features an architectural element reminiscent of a theater or amphitheater, with curved arches and tiered seating. The use of muted tones and careful shading highlights the ethereal quality of the angel and the solemnity of the tableau below.

artworks.title: The Council of Trent with Saint Thomas Vanquishing the Heretics
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink and gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of William B. O'Neal, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a gathering scene in a grand architectural setting. The image shows figures in an ornate interior that resembles a cathedral or large religious hall. The drawing includes divine figures in the upper portion amidst clouds, and a crowd seated in organized rows below. The composition suggests a religious or ceremonial event, with detailed classical architectural elements like columns and arches. The intricate line work and shading give depth and texture to the scene, creating a rich visual narrative. The details and composition may reflect the style of artists from the Mannerist period.
